criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
evidence: Official Purdue BuildingShapes feature 605 matches BIND, full name Bindley Bioscience Center, and address 1203 Mitch Daniels Blvd.
The checked-in GIS snapshot contains 191 unique exterior vertices; the reopened BIND_GIS_primary_shell has 191 base and 191 top vertices.
Using the documented local geographic conversion, symmetric GIS-to-shell Hausdorff residual is 0.00000194 m and the maximum XY bounds difference is 0.00000109 m.
findings: Identity and full primary footprint are verified; no field survey was conducted.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
evidence: The area centroid derived from the official GIS ring equals the manifest placement origin; residual is 0.00000000 m.
Applying that origin once places the reopened shell within 0.00000194 m of the projected source ring.
The complete ordered geometry is preserved without rescaling; source and shell XY bounds agree within approximately 0.000002 m.
findings: Coordinates are based on Purdue’s documented local approximation, not a field-survey coordinate system.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
evidence: Official GIS fields NUM_LEVELS=3 and CountOfFLO=3 support a three-level model; the official Bindley photograph visibly supports a multistory glazed frontage.

The GIS shell is 13.30 m high and the complete modeled collection reaches 15.80 m, including roof plant screens. The evidence record states 13.3 m eave and 14.55 m top estimates, so the highest modeled elements exceed that stated top estimate by 1.25 m.

No as-built elevation or section was included. The GIS Extrution=19 and R=48 fields have no verified vertical semantics; the photographed roof is not sufficient to validate the modeled low-slope roof or roof plant.
findings: Modeled height and roof silhouette remain estimates/unverified; the GIS floor count supports only the number of levels. The measured asset roof-plant top (15.8 m) conflicts with the evidence record’s 14.55 m overall-top estimate.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
evidence: Purdue’s building-specific exterior photo and Flad project photos support light silver/white cladding, broad glazed volumes, a prominent lobby frontage, entry canopy, and dark name wall.
The overview and entry_detail renders show light panels, a broad central glazed bay, repeated research windows, and a canopy.

The renders do not represent the photo’s large dark name wall/sign band or the documented relationship between that wall and the glazed entrance; the model instead places a small light label over glass. Exact bay spacing and unphotographed elevations remain schematic.
findings: Photo-backed cladding and glazing cues are present, but the most distinctive signage wall and entrance composition are missing; the roof-height evidence also conflicts with the modeled rooftop screens.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
evidence: The expected collection Asset_bindley_bioscience_center reopened from the saved asset with 528 objects; a collection-only library export reopened with the same count and no cameras or lights.
The reopened asset has 0 unpacked external images and 0 linked libraries.

Dedicated builder script, raw GIS snapshot, Purdue facility/facilities and Office of Research pages, building-specific photo, Flad architect page/photos/lookbook, evidence record, validation report, and three rendered views are present.

The shared manifest currently lists 904 objects while the reopened export has 528; its object-name set does not match. The preview rig remains in the saved source scene but is excluded from the exported asset collection.
findings: Coordinator should refresh manifest objects/object_count to the actual collection before treating the modular metadata as integrated.
